opening.argument: Forsage is presented as an online earning platform, with registration prompts and a Forsage x4 matrix displaying participant indicators. Its profile shows profit figures alongside partner and team sections, while the teamwork program describes results through direct partners and spillovers from other participants. Those visible features tie the displayed profits to recruitment and team activity, not merely to independent earnings. U.S. authorities charged Forsage founders and promoters over an alleged recruitment-driven crypto pyramid and Ponzi scheme. The video promotes participation in Forsage rather than warning viewers about it, supporting the position that this is a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix scam.
